<thought>To determine the number of carbonyl (C=O) groups, the most direct and inexpensive method is to obtain the IR spectrum, which shows characteristic C=O stretching bands around 1700 cm⁻¹. By examining the IR output and counting distinct strong C=O peaks, we can infer the number of carbonyl groups in the molecule. No other experiments are needed.</thought>
